output.summary: The win-rate drop is mainly a mix and measurement artifact. On 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold fell from 60 to 40 and opportunities began auto-creating. Score 40-59 opportunities (mostly LeadSpring) now close at 3.3%, and 61% of their losses were auto-closed as Unresponsive. Excluding that band, Q3 win rate is 29.4%, against 31% in Q1. Non-marketing win rate is flat, which counts against complacency, comp-plan and Brannock explanations. Rep activity is up, and median variable pay is up 3%. Slower response on high-score leads is only confounded association, because of the quote-requested flag. A LeadSpring versus Fieldline quality difference at the same score is unestablished. Re-baseline reporting and stop auto-creating opportunities for 40-59 leads. Do not run the accountability program or terminate the vendor yet.
